citation: Kristensen SL, Rorth R, Jhund PS, et al. Cardiovascular, mortality, and kidney outcomes with GLP-1 receptor agonists in patients with type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and meta-analysis of cardiovascular outcome trials. Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol. 2019;7(10):776-785.
conclusion: Pooled GLP-1 receptor agonist outcome trials show reductions in MACE, cardiovascular and all-cause mortality, heart failure hospitalization and a composite kidney outcome, with between-trial heterogeneity discussed by agent structure and trial population.
